newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-49 pct NatMut to be in in All Ordinaries - ASX.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-49 pct NatMut to be in in All Ordinaries - ASX.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Thursday that 49 percent of the capital of soon-to-be listed National Mutual Holdings Ltd would be included in the benchmark All Ordinaries Index.

The remaining 51 percent would be added to the index at the end of March 1997 conditional upon NatMut shares meeting the basic All Ordinaries Index entry criteria of market capitalisation and liquidity, the ASX said.
NatMut, to list in October, is an insurance and funds management group and is 51 percent owned by French insurance giant AXA.

NatMut has said retail investors receive shares at a price of A$1.50 per share while the company has indicated a price range of A$1.35-A$1.55 per share for institutional investors, who are expected to bid for 60 percent of the public offer.
